name: Moonstone Key
description: A hexagonal key of pale moonstone veined with silver. Runara gives it to the party when they are ready to confront Sparkrender at the Clifftop Observatory.
properties: Insert into the hexagonal indentation at the base of a marble dragon statue at D1 (observatory approach). Activates the energy bridge across the chasm to the tower ruins.
notes: Quest item — Chapter 4. Without it the party cannot reach the observatory tower easily.
